## Context

This project was carried out as part of my Data Analyst training at OpenClassrooms.

## Approach

The project analyzes undernourishment worldwide between 2013 and 2017, as part of a simulated mission within the FAO. The goal is to understand:

- global food availability,
- resource use,
- the distribution of resources between countries,
- the role of food aid

## Key Results

The analysis led to the following conclusions:

- 535.7 million people are undernourished, or 7.1% of the world population
- Global food availability would have been enough to feed 7.2 billion people
- The countries receiving the most aid are not those with the highest undernourishment rates

## Key Deliverables

<details>
<summary><b>Calculating the theoretical number of people who can be fed with plant-based products in Python</b></summary>

```python
# Transfer the plant-based data into a new dataframe
dispo_alimentaire_vege = dispo_alimentaire.loc[dispo_alimentaire['Origine'] == 'vegetale',['Zone','Disponibilité alimentaire (Kcal/personne/jour)']]
dispo_alimentaire_vege_pays = dispo_alimentaire_vege.groupby('Zone')['Disponibilité alimentaire (Kcal/personne/jour)'].sum().reset_index()
dispo_alimentaire_vege_pays_pop = pd.merge(dispo_alimentaire_vege_pays,population_2017,on='Zone',how='inner')

# Compute the number of kcal available from plant-based products
dispo_alimentaire_vege_pays_pop['dispo_vege_total_pays'] = dispo_alimentaire_vege_pays_pop['Disponibilité alimentaire (Kcal/personne/jour)'] * dispo_alimentaire_vege_pays_pop['Population']
dispo_mondiale_vege = dispo_alimentaire_vege_pays_pop['dispo_vege_total_pays'].sum()
print("En 2017, la disponibilité en produits végétaux s’élevait à",round(dispo_mondiale_vege/1000000000,1), "milliards de kcal/jour à l’échelle mondiale.")

# Compute the number of people who can be fed with plant-based products
nb_pers_pouvant_etre_nourries_vege = dispo_mondiale_vege/2940
pourcentage_population = round(nb_pers_pouvant_etre_nourries_vege/sous_nutrition_pop['Population'].sum()*100,1)
print("Sur la base d’un besoin moyen de 2 940 kcal/jour/personne, la seule production végétale mondiale aurait permis de nourrir", round(nb_pers_pouvant_etre_nourries_vege/1000000000,1),"milliards d’humains (soit près de", pourcentage_population,"% de la population mondiale).")
```
</details>

::: {.callout-tip title="Execution output"}
In 2017, the availability of plant-based products amounted to **17,449.5 billion kcal/day** worldwide.

Based on an average requirement of **2,940 kcal/day/person**, global plant-based production alone would have been enough to feed **5.9 billion people** (nearly **78.7%** of the world population).

:::
